_doc: Integrated luminosity per era, in inverse picobarns. Some triggers were not live for the whole run, so a channel can have less luminosity than its era.

_channelNote: The b-jet triggers were not live for the whole of 2017 and 2018, so the displacement-triggered channel integrates less luminosity than the era total. Use the channel value when normalising that channel.
_run3Note: Run 3 luminosities filled 2026-08-27. Basis is the certified (golden) luminosity: brilcalc totrecorded with -b 'STABLE BEAMS' and --normtag normtag_PHYSICS.json, integrated over the official golden JSON for the era, converted to pb^-1. Same recipe as the Run 2 entries (JMTucker MFVNeutralino/test/jsons/README), so every era is on one basis. The era keys are CMS MC campaign names, so Summer22 is 2022 pre-EE only and Summer23 is 2023 pre-BPix only; the post-EE and BPix data live under Summer22EE and Summer23BPix. Sub-era values come from splitting the full-year golden JSON at run 357900/359022 (2022) and 369802/369803 (2023); both cuts fall inside certified gaps, and the two halves reconstruct the full year lumi-section for lumi-section. Each source names the golden JSON used, because the value moves with the golden and normtag vintage: re-run against whatever golden JSON the ntuples were actually filtered with. There is no 2025 entry, and channels.displaced has no Run 3 entry because config/triggers/ has no Run 3 trigger list yet.
